The Campspot engine itself answered CloudFront 403 to me and stays unread.

note: Park on a peninsula in Green Lake, ~5 mi SE of Wishek; owned by the City of Wishek (transferred from state ownership in 2017) and run by the Wishek Park Board, so no longer a state park. About 12 campsites with electric hookups plus tent sites; boat ramp and dock, fishing docks, swimming area, playground. The camper pads are a gravel lot behind the shoreline tree belt and park road, not on the water. --Claude
summary: City of Wishek pages: Green Lake/Doyle Memorial Park, RV spots reserved by phone through the Park Board or the city's Campspot 'Book Green Lake' link; 'Electric and Water are available'. No rate, season, site count or amperage on the city pages; Campspot refused me (CloudFront 403). Water confirmed; booking -> campspot + url. Not waterfront stands. Pin ok. Website -> city page; phone add.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The camper lot (gravel, ~8 RVs on imagery at ~46.2050,-99.4790) sits ~80 m from the Green Lake shore behind a tree belt and the shoreline park road. A second cluster of ~8 RVs under trees at ~46.2066,-99.4747 (NE end of the peninsula, ~30-35 m from the water through trees and a road) - could not tell from the pages whether those are campsites or seasonal; view at best either way.
